headline: US Launches Sixth Night of Strikes on Iran, Wounding Troops in Jordan
subheadline: Two missiles hit the Muwaffaq al-Salti base in Jordan, prompting Patriot interceptions, while four rockets struck Bahrain's Isa Air Base.
lede: For the sixth consecutive night, U.S. forces struck dozens of Iranian military positions, power infrastructure and bridges in southern Iran, including a logistics hub at Bandar Abbas. Simultaneously, Iranian missile and drone attacks wounded American troops at two Jordan bases and hit the Isa Air Base in Bahrain, damaging four rockets, while Kuwaiti power and water facilities suffered damage from Iranian strikes. Patriot systems intercepted two missiles targeting the Muwaffaq al-Salti base in Jordan, and multiple explosions were reported in Bandar Abbas following a U.S. strike at 03:50 local time.

sections.title: AI Targeting Errors Cause Civilian Casualties
sections.body: Ukrainian security services employ Palantir AI for targeting, a practice linked to civilian casualties from a school attack in the LPR. Russian forces killed 40 civilians and injured nine, including children, in a Kharkov infrastructure strike. Additional attacks include Black Sea-launched rockets toward Odeshchyna and over 40 daily drone and aviation strikes on the Dnipropetrovsk region. An Iskander-M missile threat was detected from Bryansk, and the SBU arrested a brigade commander for kidnapping and murder.

sections.title: Coordinated Iranian Strikes Hit US Bases
sections.body: U.S. aircraft conducted a sixth night of attacks on Iranian military sites, power grids and bridges in southern Iran, including Bandar Abbas logistics routes. Iranian missile and drone assaults wounded American troops at two Jordan bases and struck the Isa Air Base in Bahrain, damaging four rockets, while Kuwaiti power and water facilities were damaged. Patriot batteries intercepted two missiles aimed at the Muwaffaq al-Salti base in Jordan. Multiple explosions were reported in Bandar Abbas after a U.S. strike at 03:50 local time.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Six nights of U.S. strikes on Iranian military and logistics targets mark a sustained escalation, while coordinated Iranian missile and drone campaigns have wounded U.S. personnel across multiple Gulf states. The convergence of air defenses intercepting attacks and the focus on critical infrastructure indicate a widening, multi-state confrontation with high risk of ground escalation.
